description: Source code for a command-line tool that processes JSON data and Mustach templates, supporting multiple JSON libraries (json-c, jansson, cJSON). It includes functions for reading files, handling command-line arguments, and processing templates.

methods.name: readfile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory.

methods.name: load_json
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a file using the selected JSON library.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the JSON data with Mustach templates.

methods.name: close_json
methods.description: Cleans up JSON objects after processing.
